reviews.title: Great keyboard
reviews.comment: This is my second SteelSeries Apex 3 keyboard.. The first one still works great I just use it on my other pc now.. The first one I have been using for about 8 yrs now and still going strong.. You can't go wrong with the SteelSeries products.
reviews.author: Jason S

reviews.title: Best budget keyboard to date
reviews.comment: This keyboard is really good for value. If you're just starting out in PC building and need a good keyboard, this is it. It's whisper quiet and the keys feel very premium for the price. The RGB lighting is highly customizable and looks great with either the Steelseries app or SignalRGB. The durability of the keyboard and the feel are very premium too, you can take it apart and clean all the keys and switch them out altogether if you don't like the OEM ones. All in all, really good keyboard for the price.

reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.comment: For the price I think this is great value.  It is very comfortable and the key strokes seem very even.  They are just a little bit loud.  The colors are nice and the software seems straightforward.  I have had a couple of instances where it seems to lock up with windows 11 or my USB port driver and I have to unplug and replug.
